bug_report_content:
id: 106
status: Fixed
summary: Array Join Munged Incorrectly
labels: ['Type-Defect', 'Priority-Medium']
stars: 3
commentCount: 6
Comment 0 (2010-02-09): $.fn.hasClass = function(selector) { return ( this.length > 0 ? !( ( ['', this[0].className, ''].join(' ') ).indexOf( ['', selector, ''].join(' ') ) == -1 ) : false ); }; munges into $.fn.hasClass=function(a){return this.length>0? (""+this[0].className).indexOf(""+a)!=-1:false}; which is not identical. Looks like there might be an issue with join and ' '.
Comment 2 (2010-02-09): Comment deleted
Comment 3 (2010-02-09): A simpler example would be: var a = ['', 'a', ''].join(' '); which evaluates to " a " But the compiler converts the code to var a="a ";
Comment 4 (2010-02-09): I fixed it last night. It'll be pushed out in the next release.
Comment 5 (2010-02-09): This issue was closed by revision r99.
